entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: The service of God should be the employment, and the praises of God the joy of every heart.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments:
People of his pasture; whom he guides, guards, and nourishes. 
 
  Hear his voice; obey his commands. 
 
Nothing should hinder us from devoting the present time to God, lest, if we procrastinate, life should end, and all opportunity and inclination to serve him be lost for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: Provocation--temptation; in the Hebrew, these words are Meribah and Massah, the same as in
, which mean "chiding," and "temptation."  The conduct of the Israelites at Massah and Meribah is mentioned as an example of their spirit of unbelief and rebellion.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: Err in their heart; err from the path of duty through an unbelieving heart.

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments:
My rest; the land of Canaan, an emblem of heaven. 
 
Though God waits upon the wicked with much long-suffering and patience, if they continue in sin he will at last exclude them for ever from the rest of heaven, and punish them according to their deserts.
